description: This file defines functions and types for parsing and rendering Markdown with Matrix-specific mention handling, including mention detection, auto-link suppression, and conversion to HTML.

methods.name: markdownToMatrixHtml
methods.description: Converts Markdown string to HTML using markdown-it with Matrix mention processing.

methods.name: resolveMarkdownMentionState
methods.description: Resolves mention state from Markdown, parsing tokens and identifying user and room mentions.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMentionsInMarkdown
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts Matrix mentions from Markdown string.

methods.name: renderMarkdownToMatrixHtmlWithMentions
methods.description: Renders Markdown to HTML and extracts mentions, returning both.
